title: Asia Golf Specialists vs Golfasian: 2027 Review
description: Comparing Asia Golf Specialists vs Golfasian for your 2026/27 Vietnam or Thailand golf tour? Compare private touring transfers, pricing, and luxury villas.
content:
Executive Summary

When planning a golf holiday to Vietnam, Thailand, or Cambodia, Golfasian is often the first name that comes to mind. As one of the largest and most established operators in the region, they have introduced thousands of golfers to Southeast Asia, and they do an excellent job at providing reliable, traditional golf packages.

Ready to start planning?

Stop researching and start packing. Our specialists engineer every detail - tee times, luxury villas, VIP transfers, and cultural experiences - built exclusively around you.

Request a Custom Quote

At Asia Golf Specialists (AGS), we are often asked how our services compare to theirs.

The truth is, both companies offer exceptional trips, but we serve entirely different types of travelers. The choice between AGS and Golfasian does not come down to which company is "better"—it comes down to the style of travel your group prefers: The Standard Hotel Experience vs. The Private Villa Experience.

Here is an objective look at how our models differ, to help you make the right choice for your upcoming trip. If you are specifically comparing Da Nang, Hanoi, or Ho Tram operators, read our dedicated guide to Golfasian Vietnam Tour Alternatives.

Private beachfront holiday villa in An Bang, Central Vietnam for luxury golf groups

Two Different Approaches to Golf Travel

Hoi An Ancient Town river by night, offering exclusive cultural immersion

Golfasian: The Scale & Volume Model

Golfasian is the industry standard for traditional golf tourism. Because they operate at a massive scale, they are uniquely equipped to handle large volumes of travelers, budget-conscious groups, and standard corporate bookings. They utilize established contracts with major 4-star and 5-star chain hotels, standard coach transfers, and pre-packaged itineraries. If you are looking for a straightforward, off-the-shelf golf trip at a highly competitive price point, Golfasian is a fantastic choice.

Tok restaurant dining overlooking lush rice paddies in Central Vietnam

Asia Golf Specialists: The Boutique, Ultra-Luxury Model

At AGS, we operate on a strictly limited-volume basis. We cater specifically to discerning luxury golfers, private club members, and discerning groups who prioritize privacy, exclusivity, and bespoke curation. Instead of standard chain hotels, we place our clients in private beachfront estates and exclusive pool villas. Instead of shared coaches, we utilize 100% private VIP logistics. We act as your "Local Guardian," custom-architecting every hour of your trip.

Exclusive private pool at a beachfront golf villa in Vietnam

The Deciding Factor: The Accommodation & Hospitality Experience

For most groups, the decision between Golfasian and AGS comes down to what happens after the 18th hole.

If your group is perfectly happy returning to a bustling resort lobby and a standard hotel room, a traditional operator is all you need.

However, if your group envisions returning from the course to a private, exclusive, private luxury estate—where a personal chef is preparing dinner, the pool is entirely yours, and your dedicated host handles every logistical detail—then Asia Golf Specialists is the only operator in the region built specifically for you.

Furthermore, because AGS employs experienced expats living directly on the ground, we provide the absolute best tailored recommendations for after-golf hospitality, dining, and nightlife. You aren't given a generic tourist brochure; you are given the keys to the city.

Beachfront garden dining and BBQ area at An Bang private villa

Featured AGS Experience: The An Bang Invitational

To understand exactly what the AGS difference looks like, consider our signature itinerary: The An Bang Invitational.

Engineered for groups who demand absolute privacy and uncompromising luxury, this experience bypasses standard tourism entirely.

What to expect:

  • The Accommodation: You will not stay in a hotel. Your group will take over a breathtaking, exclusive, private private beachfront villa on the shores of Central Vietnam.
  • The Golf: VIP access to the region's elite courses, including Hoiana Shores, Ba Na Hills, and BRG Da Nang.
  • The Experience: Private chefs, a stunning private pool, in-villa massages, private sauna, in-villa ice baths, and a spectacular beachfront garden BBQ.
  • The After-Hours: From relaxing at the Surf and Turf Beach Club to sipping craft cocktails at Te Bar in Da Nang, your expat host curates every moment.
